source_snapshot.procedure: Connect all ports and show PCIe functions for a network adapter.
source_snapshot.criteria: All PCIe-function information correct; all network ports Status_Health OK.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: PF/VF manifest, safe cabling and function-versus-port distinction required.

old_problem: The source conflates PCIe PF/VF enumeration with physical-port health and lacks the active SR-IOV mode, function manifest and safe connected-port plan.
disposition_reason: Standard read-only function inventory can be parameterized by the approved SR-IOV configuration. Port health remains a separate mapped check, preserving both Criteria without claiming that a VF owns a physical port.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row340 all 18 XLSX columns and history2936.
Retained all PF/VF/BDF properties and all physical-port health coverage under explicit mappings.
No VF, driver, IOMMU, link or cable state was changed.

test_case.test_name: NVSM network PCIe function inventory and mapped port health
test_case.purpose: Validate every expected network PF/VF and binding under the declared SR-IOV mode, then independently validate every mapped physical port's health.
required_package: Declared SR-IOV mode and expected VF counts
Port-to-adapter/peer map and loop-safe cabling plan
test_case.test_command: After manual approved cabling, run `nvsm show networkdevicefunctions` read-only; compare the complete PF/VF hierarchy and properties with the signed manifest, and evaluate every physical port through the separately approved port-health mapping.
test_case.expected_result: All expected functions appear exactly once with correct parent adapter, IDs, driver/IOMMU state and VF count; no unexpected function exists; every declared physical port independently reports Status_Health OK.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Function-tree and port-health checkpoints both must pass; port health cannot prove PF/VF enumeration, and a healthy PF/VF inventory cannot waive any physical port.
safety_gate: No VF create/destroy, bind/unbind or IOMMU/network changes
Preserve logs and stop on undeclared SR-IOV state
test_case.recovery: If cabling disrupts reachability, stop and have the network owner restore the recorded original connections; no software state is intentionally modified.

source_conflict.reason: PF/VF correctness and physical-port health are explicitly separated and linked by an approved adapter/port map.

blocked.reason: The operation is understood; platform function and port mappings are runtime inputs.

pending.unlock_condition: Approve function and port manifests before collection.
